name: com.lumera.holysheet
description:
Turns xlsx workbooks, CSV folders and Google Sheets into typed, read-only C# tables with binary data files.

The generated code and data run on any .NET: Unity clients and plain .NET servers load the same files. Includes integrity checks, optional signing, hot reload and a command line tool that builds the same output in CI.

samples.description: A scene that loads sample tables, shows them, reloads when the data changes and demonstrates tamper detection. Needs the MemoryPack package in the project.
